BMSBK1X_Silverback.overview: A highly experimental design of a massive unit able to move at unprecedented speed. By surprising enemies lying in wait under a protective ECM screen, coming online using explosive speed toward the target, with the aim of physically colliding with the target at high speed. In following up these surprise impacts, the large bore, turret mounted LB-X autocannon and quartet of pulse lasers following up, able to exploit the physical damage previously inflicted.
BMSBK1X_Silverback.capabilities: At 100 tons, the Juggernaut is outgunned by almost all opponents in its weight class, in a traditional firefight.
BMSBK1X_Silverback.history: In one engagement, a lance of Juggernauts, covering the retreat charged out from their hidden positions, colliding with the flank of pursuing Blakist forces, all but demolishing the mechs on impact. The combined heavy fire made short work of the remaining assault Level-II. Before WoB forces were able to arrive and reinforce their assault units, the Juggernauts again used their high speed to retreat with their unit.
BMSBK1X_Silverback.deployment: Currently only a handful of experimental units exist within the Storm Reaver Corps.
